page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highmem-48 is an arm64-based virtual machine instance belonging to the n4a server family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance operates on a dedicated CPU allocation model without shared-core resource contention.

This instance configuration does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network configurations do not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Users requiring persistent storage must attach external block storage volumes, and workloads requiring hardware acceleration or graphics processing are not supported by this hardware profile.

The arm64 architecture provides a power-efficient and cost-effective alternative to traditional x86 architectures for memory-intensive workloads. With 384.0 GB of RAM, the instance is structured for memory-optimized tasks such as large-scale caching, in-memory databases, data analytics pipelines, and enterprise applications that benefit from high memory density per vCPU.
